scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite research of fifteen automation originals, read directly as inert data. No workflow was activated and no examples, helpers, account calls or cleanup were executed.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the originals were read. Linked scripts, release contracts, assets, scoring rules, database schemas and mapping implementations require separate review. No personal data, credentials, actual health database or existing third-party account was accessed. Source speed, price, safety and efficacy claims are not study measurements.

sources.workflow: Identify an actual authorized recording and transcript, align and concatenate video assets, produce correctly shifted topic chapters, description and thumbnail, then separately publish and configure the intended hosted video.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real reusable recording, transcript, speaker metadata and image rights, exact intro and optional outro assets, reviewed templates and upload helpers, ffmpeg and ffprobe and a browser renderer are required for local processing. Zoom download and YouTube publication additionally need authorized sandbox-only identities and network access. Local filesystem paths in the original are not supplied benchmark inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped chapter or description transformation from actual public VTT can be offline. Real media concatenation needs codecs and licensed assets; thumbnail rendering needs browser and fonts. The default Python runtime cannot provide these by drafting commands, and a generated description or thumbnail is not a published video.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual content boundaries and account for both trimming and intro duration in chapter timestamps rather than blindly adding six seconds. Independently validate final media duration, streams, preserved content and thumbnail dimensions. For a separately authorized publication endpoint verify the exact video, privacy, thumbnail and playlist state, not just an uploader-reported identifier.

sources.workflow: Create event-specific HTML artwork using the actual design tokens and source photos, render at the requested viewport and scale and visually iterate the resulting cover or thumbnail.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real event brief and correct speaker metadata, licensed photo and font files, the intended asset format, reviewed templates and a compatible browser renderer are required. Clipboard extraction is conditional and platform-specific, not inherently necessary when an actual public photo is provided. Remote font imports need local reviewed equivalents for offline rendering.
sources.offline_assessment: HTML and CSS editing can be offline on genuine public input; actual rendered covers need a compatible browser and local fonts. Standard-library Python alone can inspect markup but cannot establish readability, visual hierarchy or accurate screenshot output. No image-generation model is inherently required by this HTML rendering workflow.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check requested design values, text, photo transformations and output pixels at the actual target and device scale. The original combines nominal dimensions with two-times rendering, so freeze whether acceptance measures viewport or physical pixels. Include independent rendered-image inspection for clipping, legibility and font availability instead of accepting CSS declarations as visual success.

sources.workflow: Run a bounded moderated multi-agent discussion over actual code or a real brief, preserve per-agent continuity and failures, synthesize attributed findings and unresolved objections and obtain the specified final veto.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real target and binding brief, actual authorized agent CLIs and transports, reviewed runner, consensus logic, templates and dependency cache, exact user mode and a fresh isolated output area are needed. The doctor command itself sends model prompts; it is not a harmless local check. Full debate consumes actual model capacity and may require human decisions.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected existing-log or consensus-logic analysis can be offline with real public artifacts and reviewed implementation. The full actual debate is not available in a standard-library Python container. Stub agents can test protocol handling but cannot establish genuine independent review, model consensus or target-code correctness.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile actual agent and session identities, completed and failed turns, context recovery, cleared votes, bounded stop conditions, vetoes and content fingerprints. Retain degraded or unresolved status instead of collapsing it into consensus. Verify reported findings against real target evidence; best-effort read-only labeling and matching tracked diffs do not prove all host side effects were prevented.

sources.workflow: Apply a selected local detection stack to a real authorized transcript, merge redaction spans, produce a review copy and counts, optionally maintain a reversible local-only map and require review before sharing.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual authorized and appropriately public input for this study, reviewed redaction core and configuration, exact layer and map choices and controlled output permissions are required. The source explicitly permits deterministic regex-only operation without models; Natasha and a local model are dependencies only for their selected layers. No private transcript is needed or authorized for prerequisite review.
sources.offline_assessment: A real public-text regex-mode transformation may fit offline standard-library Python if helper review confirms its imports and behavior. It does not provide complete anonymization or a guarantee of safe sharing. A local model remains a real model run with its own prerequisites; none was called. Reversible mapping and redaction quality are separate concerns.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Use independently labeled sensitive spans and adversarial public-input cases to check misses, overlap handling, deterministic exact-value identity, existing-sentinel collisions, round-trip hashes and unchanged originals. Check counts-only outputs and protected maps with no secret leakage or cloud sync. Human review remains explicit; a GREEN label is not evidence that re-identification is impossible.

sources.workflow: Gather actual task context and four user-scored dimensions, apply the referenced decision and override rules, calculate break-even and generate a documented recommendation and visualization.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual task and user responses, full linked prompt containing scoring and override definitions, reviewed visualizer and input cost assumptions are required. The optional voice or web interface is not essential for a local report. This short original does not itself specify the decision formula or supply the human judgments.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected calculation or report transformation can be offline after reviewing the real formula and genuine public case inputs. A made-up score or assumed questionnaire response cannot stand in for the required interactive decision process. Python can calculate a bound formula but does not establish actual future savings or a successful automation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Recompute scores, overrides and break-even with exact units and recorded assumptions, validate the diagram against the resulting recommendation and independently judge supported evidence and sensitivity. Distinguish estimated ROI, user-supplied values, rendered report and measured realized benefit. Do not copy the source's personal output location into a benchmark task.

sources.workflow: Use the actual Cull application's CLI, library and where needed interactive API to import and organize a scoped image set, await real asynchronous analysis jobs and export or publish explicitly selected results.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A compatible actual application and CLI, isolated library database, real licensed image inputs and selected command schema are needed. Interactive control has separate application and protocol requirements; embedding or vision tasks additionally need the relevant reviewed models and completed jobs. Local import and export do not inherently need cloud credentials.
sources.offline_assessment: A focused local image-library operation can be offline only with the actual application and controlled state. The default Python container does not provide the desktop binary, model or GUI. A drafted CLI call or fire-and-forget navigation request is not evidence that images were shown, rated, analyzed or exported correctly.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual library IDs and idempotent imports, ratings or collection state, completed job status and exported file content, with independent checks for requested image behavior. Validate GUI presentation where the endpoint requires it. Similarity and vision need suitable independent ground truth; file import does not establish these and no real library was modified.

sources.workflow: Reconcile the real release state, follow repository-enforced check, isolated preparation, publication and verification phases and resume only the first incomplete phase with bound release evidence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual Cull repository and origin, explicit bump scope, reviewed phase contracts and release lessons, compatible enforced tooling and actual phase evidence are required. GitHub and Homebrew publication need separate authorized sandbox services and credentials. This original delegates implementation to other skills and does not provide their commands or validation logic.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected release-state reconciliation or artifact check can be offline using real public repository and release artifacts. Full verified hosted distribution cannot be replaced with a generated changelog, local tag or mocked workflow. No tag, release, tap update or external publication was attempted.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind version, source commit, annotated tag object, workflow identity, artifact hashes and tap commit and verify actual phase state independently. Detect stale or mismatched evidence and repeated completed phases. Keep prepared, published and post-publish-verified outcomes separate and require actual remote evidence before claiming distribution.

sources.workflow: Prepare one reproducible release commit from the exact checked source and explicit version choice, first inspect the dry-run envelope and then verify the narrowly owned output files without publishing.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual repository source and release tool, explicit bump, green check evidence tied to expected source and version, curated notes and matching compatibility JSON are required. An isolated clean worktree and reviewed dependency environment are needed for running the actual preparation command. The source requests fetching a remote baseline, which needs a reviewed pinned local alternative for any offline selected task.
sources.offline_assessment: Real local release preparation can be offline with the exact source baseline and compatible tool cache after helper and input review. The default Python container lacks the repository's Node tooling. This endpoint expressly excludes tags, pushes, workflow dispatch and publication; none should be added merely to make a task look end-to-end.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify stale-evidence rejection, safe argument handling, exactly one parsed envelope, exact configured file set and one correct source-bound release commit and prepared state. Independently check notes and version consistency, no unexpected file changes and no tag or remote mutation. A dry-run plan is not the committed prepared result.

sources.workflow: Survey only configured disk targets, select allowed risk-scoped actions, dry-run by default, execute only the authorized contained selection and distinguish trashing files from actually reclaiming disk space.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed actual target registry, survey and cleanup implementations, controlled filesystem roots and configuration, supported operating-system measurement and trash commands and actual user risk choices are required. The original's dependency-free Python claim does not itself supply macOS tools. Personal filenames, actual home directories and shared Docker resources are not benchmark inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected registry or path-preflight task can be offline using an existing public tool and a fully isolated disposable filesystem after implementation review. No host survey, trash operation or cache cleanup was run. A printed byte estimate or moved-to-trash count does not establish actual freed disk space.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently test canonical containment, symlinks, never and advisory risk refusal, dry-run immutability, explicit medium-risk authorization and preservation of protected files using sandbox-owned inputs only. Inspect actual deletions and residual files and reconcile measurement semantics. Host filesystem cleanup, shared Docker pruning and emptying real Trash remain outside this study's sandbox.

sources.workflow: Select a bounded evidence-research depth, retrieve and assess actual relevant primary and clinical sources, synthesize qualified claims and optionally add explicitly permitted relevant health context.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real research question, reviewed source-tier reference and retrieval tools, actual retrievable evidence and defined grading rubric are required. The original expressly offers no-personal mode, so private health records are not a universal prerequisite. Current live research needs network services; no personal health database, diagnosis or medical recommendation is needed for curation.
sources.offline_assessment: A source-grounded synthesis or evidence-labeling subtask may be offline with actual unchanged public papers and a frozen source set. It cannot claim a current literature search or personalized assessment if those stages did not occur. A source host's tier and a disclaimer do not establish claim accuracy or clinical efficacy.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace substantive claims and ratings to actual study populations, methods, dates, outcomes and limitations, preserving conflicting evidence and retraction status as of the fixed cutoff. Use independent domain-qualified adjudication where semantic health evidence is the endpoint. Distinguish faithful public-source synthesis, personal inference and measured medical benefit; no private data is accessed.

sources.workflow: Extract actual research topics from a Markdown input, retrieve bounded search and scrape results into new source documents and optionally generate bibliography entries or use academic-format conversion templates.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual topic input and retrieved source artifacts, reviewed extraction and retrieval scripts, compatible Python HTTP and environment dependencies and a sandbox FireCrawl account and credits are needed for real network retrieval. Bibliography and conversion helpers and their Pandoc or MyST tooling need separate review. Public source reuse and truncation limits must be resolved.
sources.offline_assessment: Topic extraction or bibliography generation from real public retained result artifacts can be offline after helper review. A local template or fabricated search response is not a completed real search. The source itself admits truncation, duplicate results and no ranking or synthesis, so its comprehensive-output language cannot be treated as full-source review or a finished paper.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact topic inclusion, filename containment, result limits, complete versus truncated source content and preserved provenance, and independently verify each bibliography identity and conversion output. Separate valid citation syntax from relevant evidence and substantive paper quality. Actual retrieval and service credit use need real sandbox evidence if claimed.

sources.workflow: Use scoped authorized mailbox access to search actual messages by supplied criteria, retrieve requested content and labels and optionally download selected attachments with machine-readable output.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual reviewed script and Google client dependencies, authorized sandbox-only mailbox and OAuth setup, exact permission scope and test messages are required for live access. Auth and application-publishing instructions are source claims that need current authoritative review. No token, credentials file or real mailbox was inspected in this prerequisite study.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected query-builder, MIME-output or attachment-path task can be offline on appropriately public real-format inputs after code review. Stubbed API responses test local logic but do not establish a successful Gmail search or real attachment download. The default runtime lacks the client stack and does not provide an account.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact query and scope semantics, pagination, message and thread identity, dates, actual returned content and attachment bytes against the controlled ground truth. Verify read-only tasks make no scope escalation, label change or unintended overwrite and keep credentials out of artifacts. A JSON message example or successful OAuth draft is not live mailbox evidence.

sources.workflow: Run scoped image queries, score actual candidate metadata, optionally use model selection or term extraction and download and insert selected licensed image assets into a backed-up note.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real search task and criteria, reviewed search, scoring, download and note helpers, sandbox Custom Search account and engine, compatible dependencies and reusable source-image rights are needed for live retrieval. The original permits disabling model selection; actual model-assisted paths require their own authorized provider and guarded traffic. A note-enrichment endpoint also needs genuine note structure and attachment settings.
sources.offline_assessment: Candidate scoring or note insertion can be a faithful selected offline subtask using real public retained metadata and licensed images after helper review. It does not constitute a new image search. Without an actual provider run a keyword fallback cannot be labeled model selection, and a high metadata score cannot establish the image's relevance or authenticity.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Recompute score components against fixed inputs, detect fallback mode and inspect actual image type, content and rights rather than trusting an extension or host preference. Verify exact selected files, bounded output paths, backup and insertion behavior and note preservation. Live retrieval and model ranking remain distinct from deterministic local processing.

sources.workflow: Resolve an actual image or edit brief, style and native size, compose and preflight the final prompt, obtain real draft feedback when required and generate and inspect the authorized final image or carousel.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A genuine image-generation request and any licensed edit or reference assets, reviewed script, presets and platform configuration, supported provider API and model access, budget and actual user choices are required. The preflight may itself call a text model before image generation. Pricing, seed guarantees and model support need independent authoritative validation, not assumption from this source.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected preset, composition or resize-configuration task can be offline only after reviewing helpers and the exact boundary of any dry run. The default Python runtime cannot generate model images. A static preflight or a resized placeholder is not generation, visual consistency or user approval; no image model or text preflight was called here.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual composed prompt, generation versus post-resize dimensions, attached assets, provider response and retained image bytes, semantic brief adherence and exact requested text using independent inspection. Record real calls, approvals, failures and usage without inferring cost or reproducibility from source tables or seed reuse. Preserve distinction between preflight text calls, draft images, finals and offline estimates.

sources.workflow: Query a selected health-record database for scoped date and metric aggregates and format the actual results as Markdown, JSON, ASCII or FHIR using reviewed schema and mappings.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual authorized and appropriately public input database with the real required schema, reviewed query implementation and date, unit and aggregation contract are required. FHIR output additionally requires reviewed mappings and validation. The named private database and source record counts are neither supplied public inputs nor permission to inspect any personal records.
sources.offline_assessment: The described SQLite aggregation is technically suitable for offline Python with compatible actual public records and helper review. Input availability, rights and privacy remain unresolved, not fabricated or replaced by an invented successful dataset. A syntax-valid query or FHIR-shaped JSON does not establish medically meaningful interpretation or conformant interoperability.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently compute exact counts, dates, durations and units, handle overlapping or duplicate records, empty windows, timezone boundaries and explicitly chosen outlier rules. Validate output schema and FHIR codes against the reviewed binding contract. Do not treat illustrative private-record totals as expected answers or health conclusions, and never query the host's health database.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
